name: Île de la Cité | Private Tour
description:
Welcome to Île de la Cité, the heart of Paris!

There's so much to discover on this tour: from the history of the Notre Dame, to the oldest bridge of Paris. So put on a pair of comfy shoes and prepare to learn why this island is so important!

Note this is a walking tour and does not include a tour inside the Notre Dame or other museums.

sections.title: Itinerary
sections.content:
We will meet on the Pont Saint Louis (Saint Louis bridge) at the east of the island, we'll pass some of the main landmarks on the island including:
- the Notre Dame
- Sainte Chapelle
- Conciergerie
- Pont Neuf

If there's anything specific you'd like to see, don't hesiate to leave a note when you reserve. This is fully flexible around your needs!

**Meeting Location**: Pont Saint Louis
